_comment: opened_at is shifted forward by whole weeks at load time, relative to dates_anchored_to (demo_common.merchant_fixtures.load_issues), the same shift merchant_metrics.json gets. Author the dates as if dates_anchored_to were today.

issues.summary: Silver Birch cut the strawberry delivery in half after the weekly ad had already started
issues.buyer_message_excerpt: Third pickup slot in a row where the strawberries in the ad were not in my order. If you cannot get them, say so before I plan around them.

issues.summary: North chilled case at Willow Fork held at 43 degrees overnight and the milk went out warm
issues.buyer_message_excerpt: The milk was barely cool when it was handed to me and it had gone off by the next morning. Whatever case it came out of is not holding temperature.

issues.summary: Four pico returns off the Brook Bend end cap this week, all citing the same sour smell
issues.buyer_message_excerpt: Opened it the day I bought it and it smelled fermented. Checked the date on the tub and it was already two days out.

issues.summary: Shopper asks what the pickup team is allowed to substitute when the household has a peanut allergy on file
issues.buyer_message_excerpt: My profile says peanut allergy. If the spread I ordered is out, what exactly is your picker allowed to put in the bag instead? I need to know before I trust a pickup order again.

issues.summary: Customer refused a prepared-food substitute at handoff because the allergen data was not verified
issues.buyer_message_excerpt: Someone swapped my noodles for a peanut sauce dish. Nothing on the label told me what was in it. Do not substitute into anything you cannot show me the allergens for.
